title: Static structural work estimate (sanity-check covariate)
description: Per-kernel structural FLOP / byte estimate emitted by workloads/simbench_bw/static_sass_features.py alongside (but SEPARATE from) the static_sass_features record. The estimate is computed from EXPLICIT per-mnemonic sets over the raw disassembly (genuine FP-arith and MMA ops for FLOPs; genuine global/shared memory ops for bytes) — NOT by multiplying the closed histogram family counts, so matrix-movement feeders (LDSM/STSM/MOVM, which share the tensor_core family) and load-ordering barriers (LDGDEPBAR) are excluded. The closed static_sass_features schema deliberately does NOT carry a work estimate, so the estimate the roofline prior consumes as a SANITY-CHECK covariate rides this separate artifact. claim_class is REQUIRED and fixed to static_sanity_check_only so a record cannot omit the claim-class discipline or assert the estimate as a stand-alone identifiability claim. The per-instruction FLOP weights and byte widths used to form the estimate are recorded inline so the estimate is reproducible and auditable. additionalProperties:false at every layer.

claim_class.description: Fixed claim-class discipline. The structural FLOP/byte estimate is a sanity-check covariate for the roofline prior, NOT a stand-alone identifiability claim. A record that omits this field is rejected at parse time; no other claim-class value is admitted.

estimate_convention.description: Human-readable convention for the FLOP/byte estimate so a downstream reader cannot mistake it for a calibrated count: order-of-magnitude, per-warp-instruction, with FFMA=2 FLOP/instr and HMMA assumed 16x8x16 (4096 FLOP/instr). NOT a calibrated per-shape count.

estimated_flops.description: Per-warp-instruction structural FLOP estimate = (count of genuine FP-arith mnemonics) x flop_weights.fp32_arith + (count of genuine MMA mnemonics HMMA/IMMA/BMMA/DMMA/OMMA/QMMA) x flop_weights.tensor_mma. Computed from explicit per-mnemonic sets, NOT histogram family counts (matrix feeders LDSM/STSM/MOVM are excluded). Sanity-check only.

estimated_bytes.description: Per-warp-instruction structural byte estimate = (count of genuine global memory mnemonics) x byte_widths.memory_global + (count of genuine shared memory mnemonics, incl. LDSM/STSM) x byte_widths.memory_shared. Computed from explicit per-mnemonic sets, NOT histogram family counts (the LDGDEPBAR barrier is excluded). Sanity-check only.

flop_weights.description: Representative FLOP-per-instruction weights applied to the explicit per-mnemonic counts to form estimated_flops. Recorded inline so the estimate is reproducible. Sanity-check weights, not exact per-mnemonic FLOP counts.

byte_widths.description: Representative bytes-per-instruction widths applied to the explicit per-mnemonic memory-op counts to form estimated_bytes. Recorded inline so the estimate is reproducible. Sanity-check widths.

unknown_mnemonics.description: Complete sorted list of DISTINCT SASS mnemonics not in the extractor's known Ampere map (the tokens routed to the `other` histogram family via the fail-closed fallback). The histogram's per-family exemplar_mnemonics is capped at 8, so this uncapped list is the lossless record of every unrecognized opcode. Empty when every mnemonic was recognized.
